Synopsis:
A Russian drone strike on an ammunition depot near Kyiv killed 38 civilians and devastated the surrounding neighbourhood of Myla. Secondary explosions from stored munitions caused widespread destruction. Zelenskiy attributed the casualties to official negligence in storing military materiel near residential areas. Russia has intensified its air campaign, deploying ~2,000 drones, 1,600+ bombs, and 31 missiles in a single week. Criminal investigations have been opened. The conflict's air warfare dimension is clearly escalating.
